# The Nation

> > America's oldest weekly magazine covering progressive politics, activism, social justice, and investigative journalism since 1865.

The Nation provides in-depth political commentary, investigative reporting, and advocacy resources on issues including voting rights, reproductive justice, climate change, immigration reform, and civil liberties. The publication features voices like John Nichols, Katrina vanden Heuvel, and Rev. Dr. William J. Barber II, alongside community-driven activism through its Take Action Now program.

## Key Topics

- Progressive politics and activism
- Voting rights and election integrity
- Reproductive rights and abortion access
- Immigration reform and sanctuary movement
- Climate change and environmental justice
- Supreme Court decisions and judicial appointments
- Community organizing and resistance movements
- EMILY's List and women's political empowerment
- H.R. 7 and federal legislation
- Palestinian-Israeli conflict and US foreign policy
- Rev. Dr. William J. Barber II and moral movements
- Investigative journalism and accountability
- Civil liberties and constitutional rights
- Grassroots advocacy and petition campaigns
- Historical archives and political analysis

## Activism & Advocacy

- [Take Action](https://www.thenation.com/take-action): Main activism hub covering voting rights, immigration, and climate issues
- [Take Action Now Stories](https://www.thenation.com/take-action-now-feedback-copy): User-submitted activism stories for The Nation's Take Action Now program

## Reproductive Rights & Women's Issues

- [EMILY's List](https://www.thenation.com/emilys-list): EMILY's List advocacy on reproductive rights and H.R. 7 abortion bill

## Optional

- [The Nation Magazine Archive: Exchange, September 24, 1990](https://www.thenation.com/thenation-archive-exchange-september-24-1990): 1990 archive exchange on Palestinian-Israeli conflict and US policy
